name: security_audit
title: Security Audit -> Triage Gate -> Remediate
description: Scan target scope for security vulnerabilities (findings.v1), triage at a gate, and remediate findings.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Target directory or component to audit

brief.goal: Audit {{inputs.target}} for security vulnerabilities and emit structured findings.v1 output.
acceptance: Structured findings.v1 output listing discovered issues with severity, summary, and location

gate.prompt: Review security findings for {{inputs.target}} and approve remediation.

acceptance: Vulnerability remediated; the checks showing it is fixed are reported in the submit summary
